name: @magpie-community/gateway-paseo-bridge
description: Local Magpie route attribution for final Codex replies in Paseo

summary.en: Show the actual provider, model, and fallback attempts for supported Codex replies in Paseo. Route metadata stays on the same machine.
summary.zh: 在 Paseo 中显示受支持的 Codex 回复实际使用的供应商、模型和回退尝试。路由元数据只保存在本机。
